title: Jackdaw
blurb: Jackdaws are two species of bird in the genus Coloeus closely related to, but generally smaller than, crows and ravens (Corvus). They have a blackish crown, wings, and tail, with the rest of their plumage paler.
facts: The word Coloeus is Neo-Latin, from the Ancient Greek for jackdaws: koloiós (κολοιός).
In The Birds by Aristophanes, Euelpides speaks to his jackdaw in the first line of the play.
They come from Asia, Europe, Africa, and Siberia.
